summary_1line: Indra threatens Marutta over his priest choice, but Samvarta’s power compels Indra and the gods to attend the sacrifice peacefully.

image_candidates.scene_text: The monstrous Asura Mada looms with one jaw on earth and the other in heaven, chasing a frightened Indra with a raised pike.
Storm clouds roar as Indra approaches with thunderbolt in hand while King Marutta anxiously stands beside the ascetic Samvarta at the sacrificial altar.
Indra arrives in a radiant chariot drawn by splendid horses, surrounded by gods, as Marutta and Samvarta rise to welcome him at the glowing sacrifice.
